_meta.subject_split_note: SCI (Integrated Science) is Lower Secondary only. BIO, CHEM, PHY are IGCSE only. ENGL (Literature) is IGCSE only. MATH and ENG span both curricula.
_meta.grade_boundary_note: cambridge_lower = Grades 6-8 (Cambridge Stages 7-9). igcse = Grades 9-10 (IGCSE Years 10-11). This overrides the original task file which incorrectly had cambridge_lower = 6-9.
_meta.format_note: Each curriculum_tree entry uses grade_level (singular integer) not grade_levels (array). The seed script must iterate entries individually.
_meta.prerequisite_patch: 2026-03-25: Prerequisites normalised to canonical_codes; 137 cross-grade links added; MATH-ALG-G8-02 wrong prereq removed. Patch authored by Vidhya (curriculum) + Kramer (validation).

curricula.name: Cambridge Lower Secondary
curricula.description: Cambridge Lower Secondary curriculum for Grades 6-8 (Stages 7-9). Internationally recognised framework covering Mathematics, Integrated Science and English Language.

curricula.name: Cambridge IGCSE
curricula.description: Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education for Grades 9-10. Externally assessed qualification recognised by universities worldwide.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: Mathematics covering number, algebra, geometry, statistics and probability.

subjects.name: Integrated Science
subjects.description: Integrated science covering biology, chemistry and physics strands with scientific enquiry. Lower Secondary only.

subjects.name: English Language
subjects.description: English Language covering reading, writing, and speaking and listening.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Cambridge IGCSE Biology covering cell biology, physiology, genetics and ecology.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry covering atomic structure, bonding, stoichiometry and organic chemistry.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: Cambridge IGCSE Physics covering forces, thermal physics, waves, electricity and nuclear physics.

subjects.name: English Literature
subjects.description: Cambridge IGCSE English Literature covering poetry, prose and drama.

grades.name: Grade 11
grades.description: Cambridge AS Level Year 1 (Year 12) — seeded in later milestone

grades.name: Grade 12
grades.description: Cambridge A Level Year 2 (Year 13) — seeded in later milestone

topics.name: Number
learning_objectives: Understand and use place value for integers and decimals
Work with fractions, decimals, percentages and ratio
Solve problems involving proportion

subtopics.name: Integers and Place Value
subtopics.learning_objective: Understand the value of each digit in integers up to 7 digits; order and compare positive and negative integers on a number line.

subtopics.name: Fractions
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare and order fractions; convert between improper fractions and mixed numbers; calculate fractions of whole number quantities.

subtopics.name: Decimals and Percentages
subtopics.learning_objective: Convert fluently between fractions, decimals and percentages; calculate simple percentages of quantities and express one quantity as a percentage of another.

subtopics.name: Ratio and Proportion
subtopics.learning_objective: Write and simplify ratios; divide a quantity into a given ratio; solve simple proportion problems using the unitary method.

topics.name: Algebra
learning_objectives: Recognise and describe number patterns and sequences
Use letters to represent unknowns and write algebraic expressions
Solve simple linear equations

subtopics.name: Sequences
subtopics.learning_objective: Recognise and extend linear and simple non-linear sequences; describe the term-to-term rule in words and using algebra.

subtopics.name: Algebraic Expressions
subtopics.learning_objective: Write and simplify algebraic expressions; substitute numerical values into expressions and formulae to evaluate them.

subtopics.name: Simple Linear Equations
subtopics.learning_objective: Form and solve one-step and two-step linear equations with the unknown on one side, including equations arising from problem contexts.

topics.name: Geometry and Measure
learning_objectives: Identify and calculate angles in 2D shapes and on straight lines
Classify and describe properties of 2D and 3D shapes
Calculate area, perimeter and convert between metric units

subtopics.name: Angles and Lines
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify acute, obtuse, reflex and right angles; calculate unknown angles on a straight line, at a point, and in triangles and quadrilaterals.

subtopics.name: 2D Shape Properties
subtopics.learning_objective: Classify triangles by side length and angle; classify quadrilaterals by their properties; identify lines of symmetry and the order of rotational symmetry.

subtopics.name: Area and Perimeter
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms and compound rectilinear shapes; solve problems in context.

subtopics.name: Units and Measurement
subtopics.learning_objective: Convert between metric units of length, mass and capacity; read scales accurately; estimate and measure lengths, masses and capacities.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
learning_objectives: Collect, organise and represent data in appropriate diagrams
Calculate and interpret measures of average and spread
Express and calculate probability of simple events

subtopics.name: Data Representation
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and interpret bar charts, pictograms, line graphs and simple pie charts from frequency tables and raw data.

subtopics.name: Averages and Range
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the mean, median, mode and range from a set of raw data; interpret and compare these measures in context.

subtopics.name: Probability Scale
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the likelihood of events using probability language; express the probability of a single event as a fraction, decimal or percentage on a 0-to-1 scale.

topics.name: Number
learning_objectives: Perform calculations with fractions, decimals and percentages
Apply index notation and calculate powers and roots
Express numbers in standard form and solve proportion problems

subtopics.name: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
subtopics.learning_objective: Perform the four operations with fractions and decimals; calculate percentage increase and decrease; express percentage change.

subtopics.name: Powers and Roots
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate squares, square roots, cubes and cube roots; use index notation; apply the rules of indices for positive integer exponents.

subtopics.name: Standard Form
subtopics.learning_objective: Express large and small numbers in standard form (a × 10ⁿ where 1 ≤ a < 10); convert between standard form and ordinary numbers.

subtopics.name: Ratio and Direct Proportion
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve problems using ratio, including sharing in a given ratio; recognise and use direct proportion; construct and use proportion equations.

topics.name: Algebra
learning_objectives: Expand and factorise algebraic expressions
Solve linear equations and inequalities
Plot and interpret linear graphs

subtopics.name: Algebraic Manipulation
subtopics.learning_objective: Expand single brackets and simplify algebraic expressions; factorise expressions by extracting a common factor.

subtopics.name: Linear Equations
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve linear equations with unknowns on both sides and those involving brackets; form equations from word problems and check solutions.

subtopics.name: Inequalities
subtopics.learning_objective: Write, solve and represent linear inequalities on a number line; use correct inequality notation including strict and non-strict inequalities.

subtopics.name: Linear Graphs
subtopics.learning_objective: Plot and interpret graphs of linear functions; identify gradient and y-intercept from the equation y = mx + c; find the equation of a line from its graph.

topics.name: Geometry and Measure
learning_objectives: Apply Pythagoras theorem to right-angled triangles
Calculate area and volume of circles and 3D shapes
Perform and describe geometric transformations

subtopics.name: Pythagoras' Theorem
subtopics.learning_objective: State and apply Pythagoras' theorem to calculate the length of unknown sides in right-angled triangles; determine whether a triangle is right-angled.

subtopics.name: Circles — Area and Circumference
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the circumference and area of circles and semicircles; solve problems involving circles in real-world contexts.

subtopics.name: Volume and Surface Area
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the volume and surface area of cuboids, triangular prisms and cylinders; solve problems in context.

subtopics.name: Transformations
subtopics.learning_objective: Perform and describe rotations, reflections, translations and enlargements on a coordinate grid; identify properties preserved under each transformation.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
learning_objectives: Construct and interpret a wider range of statistical diagrams
Calculate statistics from grouped data
Calculate probabilities of combined events

subtopics.name: Statistical Diagrams
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and interpret scatter diagrams, stem-and-leaf diagrams and frequency polygons; describe correlation and identify outliers.

subtopics.name: Averages from Grouped Data
subtopics.learning_objective: Estimate the mean from a grouped frequency table; identify the modal class and the class containing the median; compare distributions.

subtopics.name: Combined Event Probability
subtopics.learning_objective: List outcomes systematically using sample space diagrams; calculate probabilities of combined events; apply P(A) + P(not A) = 1.

topics.name: Number
learning_objectives: Simplify and use surds
Apply direct and inverse proportion
Calculate compound measures

subtopics.name: Surds
subtopics.learning_objective: Simplify surds; add, subtract and multiply expressions involving surds; rationalise a denominator of the form √n.

subtopics.name: Proportional Reasoning
subtopics.learning_objective: Apply direct and inverse proportion to multi-step problems; recognise and construct graphs of direct and inverse proportion.

subtopics.name: Compound Measures
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate speed, density and pressure using the correct formulae; convert between compound units; choose appropriate units for a given context.

topics.name: Algebra
learning_objectives: Expand and factorise quadratic expressions
Solve simultaneous linear equations
Use function notation and find nth terms

subtopics.name: Quadratic Expressions
subtopics.learning_objective: Expand the product of two binomials; factorise quadratic expressions of the form x² + bx + c; recognise the difference of two squares.

subtopics.name: Simultaneous Equations
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations using the elimination and substitution methods; interpret solutions graphically.

subtopics.name: Functions
subtopics.learning_objective: Understand and use function notation f(x); find outputs for given inputs; identify the domain and range of simple functions.

subtopics.name: Nth Term of Sequences
subtopics.learning_objective: Derive and use the nth term formula for arithmetic sequences; determine whether a given value is a term in a sequence.

topics.name: Geometry and Measure
learning_objectives: Use trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles
Apply circle properties
Use similarity and enlargement to find unknown lengths

subtopics.name: Trigonometric Ratios
subtopics.learning_objective: Define and use sine, cosine and tangent ratios to calculate unknown sides and angles in right-angled triangles in 2D contexts.

subtopics.name: Circle Properties
subtopics.learning_objective: Apply the properties of tangents, chords and the angle in a semicircle; calculate arc length and sector area as fractions of a full circle.

subtopics.name: Similarity and Enlargement
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify similar figures; use scale factors to find unknown lengths, areas and volumes in similar shapes; perform enlargements with fractional scale factors.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
learning_objectives: Construct and interpret cumulative frequency graphs and histograms
Calculate probabilities using tree diagrams

subtopics.name: Cumulative Frequency
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and use cumulative frequency tables and graphs; estimate the median, lower and upper quartiles, and interquartile range.

subtopics.name: Histograms
subtopics.learning_objective: Draw and interpret histograms with unequal class widths using frequency density; calculate frequencies from a histogram.

subtopics.name: Tree Diagrams and Combined Probability
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and use tree diagrams to calculate the probability of two or more combined independent and dependent events.

topics.name: Scientific Enquiry
learning_objectives: Plan and carry out fair scientific investigations
Record and present scientific data accurately

subtopics.name: Planning Investigations
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify independent, dependent and control variables in a scientific investigation; write a testable hypothesis and design a fair test.

subtopics.name: Recording and Presenting Data
subtopics.learning_objective: Select appropriate apparatus; record results accurately in clearly labelled tables; present data as bar charts and line graphs, choosing appropriate scales.

topics.name: Biology
learning_objectives: Identify and describe the structure of plant and animal cells
Explain photosynthesis and the role of producers
Describe food chains, food webs and the roles of organisms in ecosystems

subtopics.name: Cells and Cell Functions
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify and label the structures of plant and animal cells; state the function of the nucleus, cell membrane, cytoplasm, cell wall, vacuole and chloroplasts.

subtopics.name: Photosynthesis
subtopics.learning_objective: Write the word equation for photosynthesis; describe the roles of light, chlorophyll, carbon dioxide and water; explain why plants are producers in a food chain.

subtopics.name: Ecosystems and Food Chains
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and interpret food chains and food webs; describe the roles of producers, consumers and decomposers; explain energy flow through a food chain.

topics.name: Chemistry
learning_objectives: Describe the arrangement and movement of particles in the three states of matter
Distinguish between elements, compounds and mixtures and describe separation methods
Compare the physical properties of common materials

subtopics.name: States of Matter
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the arrangement and movement of particles in solids, liquids and gases; explain melting, boiling, condensation and freezing in terms of particle theory.

subtopics.name: Mixtures and Separation Techniques
subtopics.learning_objective: Distinguish between elements, compounds and mixtures using particle diagrams; describe and explain filtration, evaporation, distillation and chromatography.

subtopics.name: Properties of Materials
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare physical properties including hardness, solubility, thermal and electrical conductivity; explain material selection for specific uses based on properties.

topics.name: Physics
learning_objectives: Identify forces and describe their effects on motion
Describe energy forms and energy transfer
Draw and interpret simple electric circuits

subtopics.name: Forces and Their Effects
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify contact and non-contact forces; describe the effects of balanced and unbalanced forces on the motion and shape of objects.

subtopics.name: Energy Forms and Transfer
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify different forms of energy (kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical, electrical, light, sound); describe energy transfers and transformations in everyday contexts.

subtopics.name: Electric Circuits
subtopics.learning_objective: Draw and interpret circuit diagrams using standard symbols; describe the difference between series and parallel circuits; predict the effect of adding components.

topics.name: Scientific Enquiry
learning_objectives: Evaluate validity and reliability of investigations
Draw evidence-based conclusions

subtopics.name: Variables and Fair Testing
subtopics.learning_objective: Distinguish between independent, dependent and control variables; evaluate the validity and reliability of an investigation design.

subtopics.name: Analysing Evidence and Drawing Conclusions
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify patterns and anomalies in data; draw conclusions based on evidence; relate findings to scientific knowledge and suggest explanations.

topics.name: Biology
learning_objectives: Describe the structure and function of key human organ systems
Explain reproduction in plants and humans
Identify the components of a balanced diet and their roles

subtopics.name: Human Organ Systems
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure and function of the digestive, circulatory and respiratory systems; explain how these systems interact to sustain life.

subtopics.name: Reproduction
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare sexual and asexual reproduction; describe fertilisation in plants and humans; explain the stages of the menstrual cycle.

subtopics.name: Nutrition and Health
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify the roles of carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals and water in the diet; explain the effects of nutritional deficiency and excess on health.

topics.name: Chemistry
learning_objectives: Describe atomic structure and use the Periodic Table
Distinguish between physical and chemical changes
Describe acids, alkalis and neutralisation

subtopics.name: Atoms, Elements and the Periodic Table
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the atom in terms of protons, neutrons and electrons; use the Periodic Table to identify element properties and group trends.

subtopics.name: Chemical and Physical Changes
subtopics.learning_objective: Distinguish between physical and chemical changes with examples; write word equations for combustion, oxidation and neutralisation reactions.

subtopics.name: Acids, Alkalis and Neutralisation
subtopics.learning_objective: Use the pH scale to classify substances as acidic, neutral or alkaline; describe the reaction between acids and bases; use indicators to determine pH.

topics.name: Physics
learning_objectives: Describe reflection and refraction of light with ray diagrams
Explain the properties and transmission of sound
Describe the structure of the solar system and celestial motion

subtopics.name: Light and Optics
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe reflection and refraction using ray diagrams; explain how lenses form images; describe dispersion of white light into a spectrum.

subtopics.name: Sound and Waves
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe how sound is produced and transmitted as a longitudinal wave; relate pitch to frequency and loudness to amplitude; explain echoes and uses of ultrasound.

subtopics.name: Earth and Space
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the solar system; explain day and night, seasons and lunar phases using models of the Earth's and Moon's motion.

topics.name: Scientific Enquiry
learning_objectives: Evaluate the quality of evidence and suggest improvements to experimental design

subtopics.name: Evaluating Investigations
subtopics.learning_objective: Evaluate the quality of evidence by identifying sources of systematic and random error; suggest improvements to experimental design to increase reliability and validity.

topics.name: Biology
learning_objectives: Explain inheritance using DNA and Punnett squares
Describe how pathogens cause disease and how the body responds
Compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration

subtopics.name: Genetics and Inheritance
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of DNA and the role of genes in inheritance; use Punnett squares to predict ratios of offspring phenotypes for a single trait.

subtopics.name: Disease and Immunity
subtopics.learning_objective: Classify pathogens as bacteria, viruses, fungi and protists; describe modes of transmission; explain how the immune system responds and how vaccination prevents disease.

subtopics.name: Respiration and Gas Exchange
subtopics.learning_objective: Write word equations for aerobic and anaerobic respiration; compare the two processes; describe the structure of the lungs and explain gas exchange across the alveoli.

topics.name: Chemistry
learning_objectives: Describe Periodic Table trends and reactivity
Explain rates of reaction using collision theory
Describe reversible reactions

subtopics.name: The Periodic Table and Reactivity
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the trends in reactivity in Group 1 and Group 7; explain reactivity using electron configuration; write displacement reaction equations.

subtopics.name: Rates of Reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: State and explain the effect of concentration, temperature, surface area and catalysts on reaction rate; use collision theory to explain these effects.

subtopics.name: Reversible Reactions
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe reversible reactions with examples such as hydration of copper sulfate; explain what happens to products and reactants when the reaction is reversed.

topics.name: Physics
learning_objectives: Describe electromagnetism and its applications
Define wave properties and calculate wave speed
Apply Newton's laws to explain motion

subtopics.name: Electromagnetism
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the magnetic field around a current-carrying conductor; explain how an electromagnet works; name applications including electric motors and relays.

subtopics.name: Wave Properties
subtopics.learning_objective: Define amplitude, frequency, wavelength and wave speed; calculate wave speed using v = fλ; distinguish between transverse and longitudinal waves.

subtopics.name: Forces and Motion
subtopics.learning_objective: Interpret distance-time and velocity-time graphs; calculate speed, acceleration and distance; state and apply Newton's First, Second and Third Laws.

topics.name: Reading
learning_objectives: Retrieve and interpret explicit and implicit information from texts
Analyse language and structural features

subtopics.name: Reading for Explicit Meaning
subtopics.learning_objective: Retrieve and select relevant explicit information from fiction and non-fiction texts to answer questions, using direct quotation or close paraphrase.

subtopics.name: Inference and Deduction
subtopics.learning_objective: Make inferences about character, mood and situation from implicit information in a text; support inferences with specific evidence.

subtopics.name: Language and Structure Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify and comment on a writer's language choices including figurative language, word choice and structural techniques, explaining their effects on the reader.

topics.name: Writing
learning_objectives: Write for different purposes and audiences
Write narrative and non-fiction texts with appropriate features

subtopics.name: Writing for Purpose and Audience
subtopics.learning_objective: Plan and write texts for different purposes (inform, entertain, persuade) and audiences; select appropriate tone, register and vocabulary.

subtopics.name: Narrative Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write engaging stories and descriptions using varied sentence structures, effective vocabulary, dialogue and imagery to create character and atmosphere.

subtopics.name: Non-Fiction Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write well-structured non-fiction texts including formal letters, reports and instructions, using appropriate layout, conventions and language features.

topics.name: Speaking and Listening
learning_objectives: Plan and deliver structured spoken presentations
Participate actively and constructively in discussions

subtopics.name: Oral Presentations
subtopics.learning_objective: Plan and deliver a structured spoken presentation using clear vocabulary, appropriate pace and eye contact to engage a specified audience.

subtopics.name: Group Discussion
subtopics.learning_objective: Participate actively in discussions by listening carefully, building on contributions, and supporting viewpoints with reasons and examples.

topics.name: Reading
learning_objectives: Analyse and interpret theme, viewpoint and language effect
Compare how two texts present ideas

subtopics.name: Inference and Interpretation
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse and interpret character motivation, theme and writer's viewpoint in literary texts; support analysis with precisely selected and embedded quotations.

subtopics.name: Language Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the effects of a writer's vocabulary choices, figurative language and narrative voice; use subject terminology accurately when commenting on language.

subtopics.name: Comparative Reading
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare how two texts present a similar theme or idea, exploring similarities and differences in the writers' language choices, structure and purpose.

topics.name: Writing
learning_objectives: Write persuasive and descriptive texts using a range of techniques
Write structured analytical paragraphs

subtopics.name: Persuasive Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write persuasive texts using rhetorical devices including direct address, tricolon, rhetorical questions, emotive language and counter-argument.

subtopics.name: Descriptive Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write atmospheric descriptions using sensory language, figurative devices and carefully chosen vocabulary to create mood and engage the reader.

subtopics.name: Analytical Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write structured analytical paragraphs using the point-evidence-explanation model; embed quotations and use subject-specific terminology to respond to literary texts.

topics.name: Speaking and Listening
learning_objectives: Participate in formal debate
Listen critically and respond to spoken texts

subtopics.name: Formal Debate
subtopics.learning_objective: Prepare and present arguments in a formal debate; respond to counter-arguments with evidence and maintain a formal, courteous register.

subtopics.name: Critical Listening
subtopics.learning_objective: Listen critically to a spoken text; identify the speaker's main argument and key supporting points; evaluate evidence and formulate relevant follow-up questions.

topics.name: Reading
learning_objectives: Critically analyse complex texts for language, structure and form
Synthesise ideas and information from multiple texts

subtopics.name: Critical Textual Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse how a writer uses language, structure and form to create meaning and achieve effects in complex literary and non-literary texts; evaluate critically.

subtopics.name: Cross-Text Synthesis
subtopics.learning_objective: Synthesise ideas and information from two or more texts; make relevant comparisons and present a coherent, evidence-based response.

topics.name: Writing
learning_objectives: Plan, draft and redraft extended written pieces
Write analytical and evaluative responses to texts

subtopics.name: Extended Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Plan, draft, redraft and proofread extended written pieces demonstrating sustained control of form, structure, style and accurate grammar and punctuation.

subtopics.name: Evaluative Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write analytical and evaluative responses to literary texts; construct and sustain a critical argument with embedded evidence and subject-specific vocabulary.

topics.name: Speaking and Listening
learning_objectives: Deliver a sustained individual presentation demonstrating rhetorical awareness

subtopics.name: Independent Presentation
subtopics.learning_objective: Deliver a well-prepared individual presentation on a chosen topic, demonstrating rhetorical awareness, appropriate register and sustained audience engagement.

topics.name: Number
learning_objectives: Apply surds and index laws including negative and fractional powers
Use standard form in calculations
Solve proportion problems and model with algebra

subtopics.name: Surds and Index Laws
subtopics.learning_objective: Simplify expressions involving surds; apply the laws of indices to evaluate and simplify expressions with integer, fractional and negative powers.

subtopics.name: Standard Form Calculations
subtopics.learning_objective: Perform multiplication, division and powers of numbers expressed in standard form; convert between standard form and ordinary notation in multi-step problems.

subtopics.name: Direct and Inverse Proportion
subtopics.learning_objective: Set up and solve problems involving direct and inverse proportion; construct and use proportional models; interpret graphs of proportional relationships.

topics.name: Algebra
learning_objectives: Manipulate quadratic expressions and solve quadratic equations
Solve simultaneous equations algebraically and graphically
Work with sequences and inequalities

subtopics.name: Quadratic Expressions and Factorisation
subtopics.learning_objective: Expand double brackets; factorise quadratic expressions including difference of two squares and trinomials; complete the square for x² + bx + c.

subtopics.name: Solving Quadratic Equations
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve quadratic equations by factorisation, completing the square and using the quadratic formula; interpret the discriminant; link solutions to graphical intersections.

subtopics.name: Simultaneous Equations
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations by elimination and substitution; solve one linear and one quadratic simultaneous equation; interpret graphically.

subtopics.name: Sequences
subtopics.learning_objective: Derive and use the nth term formula for arithmetic sequences; identify and use geometric sequences; recognise other sequence types including quadratic.

subtopics.name: Inequalities
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve linear and simple quadratic inequalities; represent solution sets on number lines and using set notation; shade regions on a coordinate grid.

topics.name: Coordinate Geometry
learning_objectives: Calculate gradient and write equations of straight lines
Calculate distance and midpoint between two coordinate points

subtopics.name: Gradient and Equations of Lines
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the gradient of a straight line; write and use the equation y = mx + c; find the equations of lines parallel and perpendicular to a given line.

subtopics.name: Distance and Midpoint
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the distance between two coordinate points using the distance formula; find the coordinates of the midpoint of a line segment.

topics.name: Geometry
learning_objectives: State and apply circle theorems
Identify and use similarity and congruence

subtopics.name: Circle Theorems
subtopics.learning_objective: State and apply all standard circle theorems to find missing angles and lengths; provide formal geometric reasons at each step of a solution.

subtopics.name: Similarity and Congruence
subtopics.learning_objective: Prove triangles congruent using SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS; use similarity ratios to find unknown lengths, areas and volumes in similar shapes.

topics.name: Trigonometry
learning_objectives: Apply trigonometric ratios in 2D and 3D problems
Use the sine and cosine rules for non-right-angled triangles

subtopics.name: Trigonometric Ratios in 2D and 3D
subtopics.learning_objective: Use sine, cosine and tangent ratios to calculate missing sides and angles in right-angled triangles; extend to 3D problems involving trigonometry.

subtopics.name: Sine Rule and Cosine Rule
subtopics.learning_objective: Apply the sine rule and cosine rule to find unknown sides and angles in non-right-angled triangles; calculate the area of a triangle using ½ab sin C.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
learning_objectives: Construct and interpret cumulative frequency diagrams and box plots
Draw and interpret histograms with unequal class widths
Calculate probability using Venn diagrams and tree diagrams

subtopics.name: Cumulative Frequency and Box Plots
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and interpret cumulative frequency diagrams and box-and-whisker plots; estimate median, quartiles, percentiles and interquartile range.

subtopics.name: Histograms with Unequal Class Widths
subtopics.learning_objective: Draw and interpret histograms with unequal class widths using frequency density; calculate frequencies and class widths from a histogram.

subtopics.name: Probability with Venn Diagrams and Tree Diagrams
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate probability using Venn diagrams, two-way tables and tree diagrams; apply the addition rule and multiplication rule for independent events.

topics.name: Number
learning_objectives: Solve reverse percentage and compound growth problems
Apply upper and lower bounds to calculations

subtopics.name: Compound Growth and Decay
subtopics.learning_objective: Solve reverse percentage problems; calculate compound interest and depreciation; apply exponential growth and decay models to real-world problems.

subtopics.name: Bounds and Error Intervals
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate upper and lower bounds of measurements rounded to a given degree of accuracy; use bounds to find the limits of calculated quantities.

topics.name: Algebra
learning_objectives: Understand and use function notation and transformations of graphs
Construct algebraic proofs

subtopics.name: Functions and Inverse Functions
subtopics.learning_objective: Use function notation; find composite and inverse functions; sketch and interpret graphs of standard functions including quadratic, cubic and reciprocal.

subtopics.name: Transformation of Graphs
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe and apply translations f(x) + a, reflections f(−x) and −f(x), and stretches f(ax) and af(x) to graphs of functions.

subtopics.name: Algebraic Proof
subtopics.learning_objective: Construct and present algebraic proofs using manipulation and reasoning; prove identities; disprove statements using counter-examples.

topics.name: Mensuration
learning_objectives: Calculate arc length, sector area and segment area
Calculate surface area and volume of 3D shapes

subtopics.name: Arc Length and Sector Area
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate arc length and sector area as fractions of a full circle; calculate the area of a segment; solve problems involving circles in context.

subtopics.name: Surface Area and Volume of 3D Shapes
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the surface area and volume of spheres, cones, pyramids and composite 3D shapes; solve problems including frustums.

topics.name: Vectors
learning_objectives: Use vector notation and perform vector operations
Apply vectors to geometric proof

subtopics.name: Vector Notation and Operations
subtopics.learning_objective: Represent vectors using column notation; add, subtract and multiply vectors by a scalar; calculate the magnitude of a vector.

subtopics.name: Geometric Applications of Vectors
subtopics.learning_objective: Use position vectors and vector addition to describe geometric paths; prove geometric results such as lines being parallel or points being collinear.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
learning_objectives: Critically evaluate statistical investigations
Calculate conditional probability

subtopics.name: Statistical Investigation and Sampling
subtopics.learning_objective: Plan and critically evaluate statistical investigations; identify bias in sampling methods (convenience, systematic, stratified) and suggest improvements.

subtopics.name: Conditional Probability
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate conditional probability using two-way tables, Venn diagrams and tree diagrams; apply P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B).

topics.name: Cell Biology
learning_objectives: Compare the structure of plant, animal and bacterial cells
Explain transport across cell membranes
Describe mitosis and meiosis

subtopics.name: Cell Structure and Organelles
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare and contrast the structure of plant, animal and bacterial cells; state the function of each organelle including mitochondria, ribosomes and the endoplasmic reticulum.

subtopics.name: Cell Membrane Transport
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain diffusion, osmosis and active transport in terms of particle movement; describe their roles in absorption, gas exchange and mineral uptake in living organisms.

subtopics.name: Cell Division — Mitosis and Meiosis
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the stages of mitosis and meiosis; explain why mitosis is required for growth and repair; explain why meiosis produces genetic variation and is essential for sexual reproduction.

topics.name: Biological Molecules and Enzymes
learning_objectives: Identify the roles and tests for biological molecules
Explain enzyme action and the factors that affect it

subtopics.name: Biological Molecules
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify the roles of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and water in living organisms; use food tests (Benedict's, iodine, biuret and emulsion) to identify each food group.

subtopics.name: Enzyme Action and Factors
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain enzyme action using the lock-and-key model; describe and explain the effects of temperature, pH and substrate concentration on enzyme activity with reference to denaturation.

topics.name: Plant Biology
learning_objectives: Describe photosynthesis and the factors affecting its rate
Explain transport in plants and transpiration

subtopics.name: Photosynthesis and Limiting Factors
subtopics.learning_objective: Write the balanced equation for photosynthesis; describe and explain the effect of light intensity, CO₂ concentration and temperature as limiting factors on the rate of photosynthesis.

subtopics.name: Transport in Plants and Transpiration
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure and function of xylem and phloem; explain the process of transpiration; describe the factors affecting transpiration rate and how to investigate them.

topics.name: Human Physiology
learning_objectives: Describe digestion and absorption in the alimentary canal
Explain gas exchange in the lungs

subtopics.name: Digestion and Absorption
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure and function of the alimentary canal; explain chemical digestion by enzymes and the absorption of nutrients into the blood.

subtopics.name: Gas Exchange in the Lungs
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the lungs and alveoli; explain how the alveoli are adapted for efficient gas exchange; describe the mechanism of breathing.

topics.name: Reproduction
learning_objectives: Describe reproduction in humans and flowering plants

subtopics.name: Human Reproduction
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the male and female reproductive systems; explain fertilisation, implantation, the role of the placenta and the stages of birth.

subtopics.name: Reproduction in Flowering Plants
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe self-pollination and cross-pollination; explain fertilisation in flowering plants; describe the conditions required for seed germination.

topics.name: Human Physiology
learning_objectives: Describe the circulatory system and transport of substances
Explain coordination and response in the nervous and endocrine systems
Describe excretion and osmoregulation in the kidney
Explain disease, immunity and vaccination

subtopics.name: The Circulatory System
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the heart and blood vessels; explain the cardiac cycle and the double circulatory system; describe the composition and functions of blood components.

subtopics.name: Coordination and Response
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the nervous system; explain reflex arcs; describe the roles of key hormones including adrenaline, insulin and glucagon in homeostasis.

subtopics.name: Excretion and Osmoregulation
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the kidney nephron; explain the processes of ultrafiltration and selective reabsorption; describe how the kidney regulates water balance.

subtopics.name: Disease and Immunity
subtopics.learning_objective: Classify pathogens by type; describe routes of transmission; explain how the immune system responds to infection; distinguish between active and passive immunity and describe vaccination.

topics.name: Reproduction and Genetics
learning_objectives: Predict inheritance patterns using genetic diagrams
Explain continuous and discontinuous variation and the causes of mutations

subtopics.name: Inheritance and Genetic Diagrams
subtopics.learning_objective: Use Punnett squares to predict the inheritance of monohybrid traits; explain codominance, multiple alleles and sex-linked inheritance with worked examples.

subtopics.name: Variation and Mutation
subtopics.learning_objective: Distinguish between continuous and discontinuous variation; explain how gene mutations and environmental factors contribute to variation; describe the consequences of mutation.

topics.name: Evolution and Ecology
learning_objectives: Explain natural selection and evidence for evolution
Describe the carbon and nitrogen cycles and human impact on ecosystems
Evaluate biotechnology and genetic engineering

subtopics.name: Natural Selection and Evolution
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how natural selection leads to evolution over time; describe evidence for evolution including fossil records, antibiotic resistance and selective breeding.

subtopics.name: Ecosystems and Human Impact
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the carbon and nitrogen cycles; explain the effects of deforestation, pollution, climate change and over-exploitation on ecosystems and biodiversity.

subtopics.name: Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the principles of selective breeding and genetic engineering including gene cloning; evaluate the benefits and ethical concerns of biotechnology.

topics.name: Particles and Atomic Structure
learning_objectives: Describe atomic structure and use the Periodic Table
Define isotopes and calculate relative atomic mass

subtopics.name: Atomic Structure and the Periodic Table
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the atom in terms of protons, neutrons and electrons; determine electronic configuration; explain how the Periodic Table is arranged by atomic number and group.

subtopics.name: Isotopes and Relative Atomic Mass
subtopics.learning_objective: Define isotopes and relative atomic mass; calculate RAM from isotopic abundances; describe the use of mass spectrometry and radioactive isotopes.

topics.name: Chemical Bonding and Structure
learning_objectives: Explain and represent ionic, covalent and metallic bonding
Describe giant and simple molecular structures and their properties

subtopics.name: Ionic Bonding and Structure
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the formation of ionic bonds by electron transfer; draw dot-and-cross diagrams for common ionic compounds; describe the giant ionic lattice and explain its properties.

subtopics.name: Covalent Bonding and Structure
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain covalent bond formation by electron sharing; draw dot-and-cross diagrams; distinguish between simple molecular and giant covalent structures and explain their properties.

subtopics.name: Metallic Bonding and Properties
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the metallic bond model (positive ions in a sea of delocalised electrons); explain physical properties of metals including conductivity, malleability and high melting point.

topics.name: Stoichiometry
learning_objectives: Calculate moles and determine empirical formulae
Perform stoichiometric calculations from balanced equations

subtopics.name: Moles and Chemical Formulae
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate molar mass; determine the number of moles from mass; find empirical and molecular formulae from experimental percentage composition data.

subtopics.name: Reacting Quantities and Yield
subtopics.learning_objective: Balance symbol equations; use mole ratios to calculate masses and volumes of reactants and products; calculate theoretical yield and percentage yield.

topics.name: Physical Chemistry
learning_objectives: Describe exothermic and endothermic reactions and energy diagrams
Explain factors affecting rates of reaction using collision theory

subtopics.name: Energetics
subtopics.learning_objective: Define exothermic and endothermic reactions; draw and interpret energy profile diagrams; calculate enthalpy changes using bond energies or Hess's law.

subtopics.name: Rates of Reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the effect of concentration, temperature, particle size, pressure and catalysts on reaction rate; explain using collision theory; interpret rate graphs.

topics.name: Physical Chemistry
learning_objectives: Apply Le Chatelier's principle to equilibrium systems
Describe electrolysis of molten and aqueous compounds

subtopics.name: Reversible Reactions and Equilibrium
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain dynamic equilibrium; apply Le Chatelier's principle to predict the effect of changing temperature, pressure and concentration on the position of equilibrium.

subtopics.name: Electrochemistry
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe electrolysis of molten and aqueous electrolytes; predict the products at the anode and cathode; explain the products using the reactivity series and ion concentration.

topics.name: Inorganic Chemistry
learning_objectives: Prepare salts and describe reactions of acids
Apply the reactivity series to metals
Explain atmospheric chemistry and pollution

subtopics.name: Acids, Bases and Salt Preparation
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the reactions of acids with metals, metal oxides, hydroxides and carbonates; prepare soluble salts by neutralisation and titration; prepare insoluble salts by precipitation.

subtopics.name: Metals and the Reactivity Series
subtopics.learning_objective: Order metals by reactivity; explain displacement reactions; describe the extraction of metals by reduction and electrolysis; link extraction method to position in reactivity series.

subtopics.name: Atmospheric Chemistry and Environment
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the composition of the atmosphere; explain the enhanced greenhouse effect; describe the causes and consequences of acid rain and atmospheric pollution.

topics.name: Organic Chemistry
learning_objectives: Describe the structure and reactions of alkanes and alkenes
Describe alcohols and carboxylic acids and their reactions
Explain polymer formation and evaluate environmental impact

subtopics.name: Hydrocarbons — Alkanes and Alkenes
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure and properties of alkanes and alkenes; explain substitution in alkanes and addition in alkenes; describe cracking and its industrial importance.

subtopics.name: Alcohols and Carboxylic Acids
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the structure, properties and reactions of ethanol and ethanoic acid; explain fermentation and the production of ethanol; describe esterification.

subtopics.name: Polymers and Environmental Impact
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the formation of addition and condensation polymers; evaluate the environmental impact of synthetic polymers including disposal and biodegradability.

topics.name: Forces and Motion
learning_objectives: Interpret and draw motion graphs
Apply Newton's laws to motion problems
Apply conservation of energy and momentum

subtopics.name: Kinematics and Motion Graphs

subtopics.name: Newton's Laws of Motion
subtopics.learning_objective: State Newton's three laws; apply F = ma to calculate resultant force, mass or acceleration; explain terminal velocity in terms of balanced forces.

subtopics.name: Work, Energy and Power
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate work done, gravitational potential energy, kinetic energy and power; apply the principle of conservation of energy to multi-step problems.

subtopics.name: Momentum and Impulse
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate momentum using p = mv; apply the principle of conservation of momentum to collisions and explosions; explain impulse as the change in momentum.

topics.name: Thermal Physics
learning_objectives: Explain changes of state and calculate thermal energy
Describe modes of thermal energy transfer

subtopics.name: Thermal Properties and Changes of State
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain changes of state using kinetic theory; calculate thermal energy for temperature change using Q = mcΔT; calculate energy for a change of state using Q = mL.

subtopics.name: Thermal Energy Transfer
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe conduction, convection and radiation; explain the factors affecting the rate of each; apply to real-world contexts such as building insulation and climate.

topics.name: Waves
learning_objectives: Define wave properties and calculate wave speed
Explain reflection, refraction and total internal reflection of light
Describe the electromagnetic spectrum and its uses

subtopics.name: Wave Properties and Calculations
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe transverse and longitudinal waves; define amplitude, frequency, wavelength and period; calculate wave speed using v = fλ; interpret wave diagrams.

subtopics.name: Light — Reflection, Refraction and TIR
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe reflection and refraction using ray diagrams; calculate the critical angle; explain total internal reflection and describe its applications in optical fibres.

subtopics.name: The Electromagnetic Spectrum
subtopics.learning_objective: List the regions of the EM spectrum in order of wavelength and frequency; describe the properties, sources and uses of each region; explain the hazards of ionising radiation.

topics.name: Waves
learning_objectives: Describe sound waves and the uses of ultrasound

subtopics.name: Sound and Ultrasound
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe how sound waves are produced and transmitted as longitudinal waves; explain the uses of ultrasound in medicine and industry; describe the limits of human hearing.

topics.name: Electricity and Magnetism
learning_objectives: Analyse series and parallel circuits using Ohm's law
Calculate electrical power and energy
Explain the motor effect and electromagnetic induction
Explain how transformers work and why they are used in the national grid

subtopics.name: Circuit Analysis and Ohm's Law
subtopics.learning_objective: Apply Ohm's law to calculate resistance, current and voltage; analyse series and parallel circuits using the rules for current, voltage and resistance.

subtopics.name: Electrical Power and Energy
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate electrical power using P = IV = I²R; calculate electrical energy transferred; determine the cost of using household appliances; describe domestic wiring and safety features.

subtopics.name: Electromagnetism and the Motor Effect
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the magnetic field around a current-carrying conductor; explain the motor effect using F = BIL; describe electromagnetic induction and Faraday's law qualitatively.

subtopics.name: Transformers and the National Grid
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how a transformer works using the principle of electromagnetic induction; apply the transformer equation; explain why high-voltage transmission is used in the national grid.

topics.name: Nuclear Physics
learning_objectives: Describe the properties and uses of ionising radiation
Calculate radioactive decay using half-life
Describe nuclear fission and fusion and their applications

subtopics.name: Radioactivity and Ionising Radiation
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the properties of alpha, beta and gamma radiation including charge, mass and penetrating power; explain ionisation; describe uses of radioactive isotopes in medicine and industry.

subtopics.name: Radioactive Decay and Half-Life
subtopics.learning_objective: Define half-life; calculate the activity and amount of substance remaining after a given number of half-lives; interpret decay graphs and use them to determine half-life.

subtopics.name: Nuclear Fission, Fusion and Energy
subtopics.learning_objective: Distinguish between nuclear fission and fusion; explain the chain reaction in a nuclear reactor; evaluate the advantages and risks of nuclear power compared to other energy sources.

topics.name: Reading
learning_objectives: Retrieve, interpret and analyse information from unseen texts
Analyse language effects and write accurate summaries

subtopics.name: Language Analysis for Effect

subtopics.name: Summary Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Select and synthesise relevant information from a source text; write a focused, accurate summary in your own words, avoiding direct quotation.

topics.name: Writing

Write narrative and descriptive compositions

subtopics.name: Narrative and Descriptive Writing
subtopics.learning_objective: Write narrative or descriptive compositions with effective use of vocabulary, varied sentence structures, structural devices and a consistent voice to engage the reader.

topics.name: Reading
learning_objectives: Compare how two writers achieve effects across texts
Evaluate a writer's effectiveness with a sustained critical perspective

subtopics.name: Comparative Textual Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare how two writers use language, structure and form to achieve different effects and influence the reader; evaluate which is more effective, sustaining a critical perspective.

topics.name: Writing
learning_objectives: Write argumentative and persuasive texts with a clear sustained viewpoint
Write extended compositions with sophisticated style and structure

subtopics.learning_objective: Write a coherent argument or persuasive text using a range of rhetorical techniques; structure ideas logically; maintain a clear, sustained viewpoint throughout.

subtopics.name: Extended Composition
subtopics.learning_objective: Write extended narrative or descriptive compositions demonstrating full control of register, style, structure and sophisticated vocabulary choices throughout.

topics.name: Poetry
learning_objectives: Analyse set and unseen poems for language, form and context
Compare how two poets explore a theme

subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse poems from the set anthology for meaning, language, form, structure and context; compare how two poets explore a similar theme, evaluating their methods.

subtopics.name: Unseen Poetry
subtopics.learning_objective: Respond to an unseen poem by analysing how the poet uses language, structure, tone and form to create effects; support all points with close textual reference.

topics.name: Prose
learning_objectives: Analyse the set prose text for character, theme and narrative technique

subtopics.name: Set Text Prose Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse the set prose text for character development, theme, narrative technique and the writer's use of language and structure to create meaning and effect.

topics.name: Drama
learning_objectives: Analyse the set play for character, conflict and dramatic technique

subtopics.name: Set Play Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse the set dramatic text for character development, conflict, dramatic irony and theatrical devices; explain how the playwright creates tension and meaning.

topics.name: Poetry
learning_objectives: Write a sustained comparative essay on two anthology poems

subtopics.learning_objective: Write a sustained comparative essay discussing how two poems from the anthology present a theme; analyse the poets' methods and evaluate their relative effectiveness.

topics.name: Prose
learning_objectives: Write extended analytical essays on the set prose text
Analyse unseen prose passages for language, character and atmosphere

subtopics.name: Extended Prose Essay
subtopics.learning_objective: Write an extended analytical essay evaluating the writer's methods and their effects on the reader in the set prose text; sustain a critical argument with embedded evidence.

subtopics.name: Unseen Prose Analysis
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse an unseen prose passage, discussing how the writer creates character, atmosphere and tension through language, structure and narrative technique.

topics.name: Drama
learning_objectives: Analyse how a playwright uses dramatic structure, context and stagecraft to create meaning

subtopics.name: Drama in Context and Performance
subtopics.learning_objective: Analyse how a playwright uses dramatic structure, stagecraft and historical or social context to create meaning; evaluate how production choices would shape the audience's experience.
